summary: Two-level lookout on Eureka Mountain near Cherryville, built in 1957 after a 1930 horse trail and a 1953 road; now a summer-access recreation site.

facts.design: Two-level building with a white roof

access.note: Listed as a recreation site. The summit road is unpaved and steep, and is typically reachable only in summer. No source gives a closure or permit rule for the lookout.

events.note: A horse trail to the summit was established.
The road to the summit was completed.
Present structure built to support wildfire management; the OpenStreetMap start date agrees.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The road guide and the brief both give the Regional District of Central Kootenay; the map gazetteer gives the Regional District of North Okanagan. The record keeps the brief's value because the road guide agrees with it, and the story reports both. The boundary should be checked before publication.

notes_for_editor: Campingmap.ca and campguide.ca carry the Recreation Sites text (horse trail 1930, road 1953, building 1957, elevation 6,500 ft) in search snippets, but fetch_text returned no body text for either, so neither is cited. The Facebook group post yielded only its title. Staffing and fire events were not found. Height was not found in any readable source. The brief's regional district conflicts with the Mapcarta gazetteer; check the boundary before publishing.
